title: Update Container Dockerfile
description: Fetch updated Dockerfile, commit it, and rebuild to ensure the course container stays current when dependencies change.

steps.description: Five commands to update and rebuild the container.
Directory: cd to .devcontainer folder in your clone.
Download: curl fetches the latest Dockerfile from the course gh-pages.
Version control: git add and commit the updated Dockerfile with a descriptive message.
Rebuild: docker compose build rebuilds the image, docker compose run --rm cs357 starts the updated container.
